    35	function deepFreeze(v) {
    36	  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
    37	  Object.freeze(v);
    38	  var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
    39	  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) deepFreeze(v[names[i]]);
    40	  return v;
    41	}

   329	  function _snapshotPlainShape(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode, opts) {
   330	    opts = opts || {};
   331	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) {
   332	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   333	    }

   336	    }

   339	    }
   340	    var names;
   341	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); } catch (e) {
   342	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor read failed' };
   343	    }
   344	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   345	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   346	      var k = names[i];
   347	      // Reject unknown own key — caller cannot smuggle `class`, `outcomeId`, `confounders`,
   348	      // etc. into the input wrapper.
   349	      if (allowedKeys.indexOf(k) === -1) {
   350	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown own key ' + k };
   351	      }
   352	      var d;
   353	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); } catch (e) {
   354	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'descriptor inaccessible' };
   355	      }
   356	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) {
   357	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable key ' + k };
   358	      }
   359	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   360	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor key ' + k };
   361	      }
   362	      snap[k] = d.value;
   363	    }
   364	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   365	  }

   367	  // Codex E3-R1-03 closure: dense-array enforcement. Reject sparse arrays (any index in
   368	  // 0..length-1 missing an enumerable data descriptor → hole) AND reject any own key
   369	  // other than 'length' or a canonical numeric index (no Symbol keys, no string names,
   370	  // no negative / fractional / leading-zero indices). The walk indexes BY index, not by
   371	  // getOwnPropertyNames enumeration order, so a hostile array that puts named own keys
   372	  // first cannot smuggle a hole past the cap check.
   373	  function _snapshotArrayShape(a, invalidCode) {
   374	    if (!_isPlainArray(a)) {
   375	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'not array' };
   376	    }
   377	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(a)) {
   378	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key on array' };
   379	    }
   380	    var aLen;
   381	    try { aLen = a.length; } catch (e) {
   382	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array length inaccessible' };
   383	    }
   384	    if (typeof aLen !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(aLen) || aLen < 0 || aLen > ARRAY_CAP) {
   385	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.ARRAY_CAP_EXCEEDED], detail: 'array len ' + aLen };
   386	    }
   387	    // First sweep: enumerate own keys and reject ANY name other than 'length' or a
   388	    // canonical numeric index in [0, aLen). Reject Symbol keys (already above), reject
   389	    // non-enumerable / accessor / non-data descriptors on indices.
   390	    var names;
   391	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(a); } catch (e) {
   392	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array desc inaccessible' };
   393	    }
   394	    for (var ni = 0; ni < names.length; ni++) {
   395	      var nm = names[ni];
   396	      if (nm === 'length') continue;
   397	      if (!ARRAY_INDEX_RE.test(nm)) {
   398	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'non-index own key on array: ' + nm };
   399	      }
   400	      var idxN = +nm;
   401	      if (idxN < 0 || idxN >= aLen) {
   402	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array index out of [0,length): ' + nm };
   403	      }
   404	      var dn;
   405	      try { dn = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, nm); } catch (e) {
   406	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail' };
   407	      }
   408	      if (!dn || dn.enumerable !== true) {
   409	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + nm };
   410	      }
   411	      if (typeof dn.get === 'function' || typeof dn.set === 'function') {
   412	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + nm };
   413	      }
   414	    }
   415	    // Second sweep: walk by index 0..aLen-1. Every index MUST have an OWN enumerable
   416	    // data descriptor (no holes, no prototype-inherited values).
   417	    var snap = [];
   418	    for (var i = 0; i < aLen; i++) {
   419	      var key = '' + i;
   420	      var d;
   421	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(a, key); } catch (e) {
   422	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'array elt desc fail at ' + i };
   423	      }
   424	      if (!d) {
   425	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'sparse array hole at index ' + i };
   426	      }
   427	      if (d.enumerable !== true) {
   428	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enumerable array elt at ' + i };
   429	      }
   430	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   431	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor array elt at ' + i };
   432	      }
   433	      snap.push(d.value);
   434	    }
   435	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   436	  }
   437	
   438	  function _snapshotOpts(optsIn) {
   439	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   440	    if (optsIn === undefined || optsIn === null) return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   441	    var r = _snapshotPlainShape(optsIn, OPTS_KEYS_ALLOWED, CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
   442	    if (r.valid !== true) return r;
   443	    // Type-check each opt.
   444	    if (r.snapshot.clock !== undefined && r.snapshot.clock !== null && typeof r.snapshot.clock !== 'function') {
   445	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.clock not function' };
   446	    }
   447	    if (r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== null
   448	        && typeof r.snapshot.referenceNowMs !== 'number') {
   449	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.referenceNowMs not number' };
   450	    }
   451	    if (r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== undefined && r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== null
   452	        && (typeof r.snapshot.maxAgeMs !== 'number' || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_INTEGER(r.snapshot.maxAgeMs) || r.snapshot.maxAgeMs < 0)) {
   453	      return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], detail: 'opts.maxAgeMs invalid' };
   454	    }
   455	    return { valid: true, snapshot: r.snapshot };
   456	  }
   457	
   458	  // ---------- Deterministic ID generator -------------------------------------------------------
   459	  // outcomeId is deterministic from (experimentId, changeId). No clock leak.
   460	  function _hash32(s) {
   461	    var h = 0x811c9dc5;
   462	    var len = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   463	    for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   464	      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
   465	      h = (h + ((h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24))) >>> 0;
   466	    }
   467	    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
   468	  }
   469	  function _fnv2(s) {
   470	    var slen = typeof s === 'string' ? s.length : 0;
   471	    return _hash32(s) + _hash32(s + '|' + slen);
   472	  }
   473	  function _outcomeId(experimentId, changeId) {
   474	    return 'outcome_' + _fnv2('outcome|' + experimentId + '|' + changeId);
   475	  }

   477	  // ---------- Main entry: classifyOutcome -----------------------------------------------------
   478	  /**
   479	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   480	   *
   481	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):
   482	   *   0.  intrinsic integrity (captures + contract surfaces still frozen)
   483	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   484	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   485	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   486	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   487	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   488	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   489	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   490	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   491	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)
   492	   *   10. freshness check on experiment.createdAt + appliedChange.appliedAt
   493	   *   11. comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence)
   494	   *   12. control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders precedence)
   495	   *   13. data-quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade
   496	   *   14. compose outcome
   497	   *   15. validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape
   498	   *   16. envelope byte cap
   499	   *   17. deep-freeze + register
   500	   */
   501	  function classifyOutcome(inputIn, optsIn) {

   612	      // Each side-effect must be a plain { i18nKey, params } object.

   799	      // ---- Step 11: comparison-validity computation (invalid_comparison precedence) ------
   800	      var limitations = [];
   801	      var classDecision = null;
   802	      var confounders = [];
   803	
   804	      if (crossCase || crossSession || noExplicitReference || lowComparability) {
   805	        classDecision = 'invalid_comparison';
   806	        if (crossCase) limitations.push(CODES.LINKAGE_PARENT_MISSING);
   807	        if (crossSession) limitations.push(CODES.LIMITATION_CROSS_SESSION_FOLLOW_UP);
   808	        if (noExplicitReference) limitations.push(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
   809	        if (lowComparability && limitations.indexOf(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT) === -1) {
   810	          limitations.push(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
   811	        }
   812	      } else {
   813	        // ---- Step 12: control-variable integrity (inconclusive_due_to_confounders) ------
   814	        // Every declared experiment.controlVariables[].name MUST appear in observations.
   815	        // Codex E3-R1-01 closure: presence check uses captured descriptor lookup so an
   816	        // ambient Object.create rebind cannot inject phantom membership.
   817	        // Codex E3-R2-03 closure: experiment.controlVariables MUST be dense + index-only
   818	        // own keys (E1's nested-descriptor audit does not catch sparse arrays — sparse
   819	        // [] returns only the 'length' own key and slips through). Snapshot via the same
   820	        // captured-array sweep used for observation arrays so a hostile sparse array
   821	        // attached to a frozen experiment cannot silently bypass missing-CV detection.
   822	        var declaredCvR = _snapshotArrayShape(experiment.controlVariables || [], CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLES_INVALID);
   823	        if (declaredCvR.valid !== true) {
   824	          return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(declaredCvR.reasonCodes, { detail: 'experiment.controlVariables: ' + declaredCvR.detail });
   825	        }
   826	        var declaredCv = declaredCvR.snapshot;
   827	        for (var dci = 0; dci < declaredCv.length; dci++) {
   828	          var declared = declaredCv[dci];
   829	          if (declared === null || typeof declared !== 'object') continue;
   830	          var declaredName = declared.name;
   831	          if (!_nonEmptyStr(declaredName)) continue;
   832	          if (!_capturedSetHas(observedCvSet, declaredName)) {
   833	            confounders.push(declaredName);
   834	          }
   835	        }
   836	        if (confounders.length > 0) {
   837	          classDecision = 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders';
   838	          if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING) === -1) {
   839	            limitations.push(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING);
   840	          }
   841	        } else {
   842	          // Out-of-range CVs become confounders.
   843	          var outOfRange = [];
   844	          for (var ki = 0; ki < controlVariableObservations.length; ki++) {
   845	            var cvo = controlVariableObservations[ki];
   846	            if (cvo.withinRange !== true) outOfRange.push(cvo.name);
   847	          }
   848	          if (outOfRange.length > 0) {
   849	            classDecision = 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders';
   850	            confounders = outOfRange;
   851	            if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_OUT_OF_RANGE) === -1) {
   852	              limitations.push(CODES.CONTROL_VARIABLE_OUT_OF_RANGE);
   853	            }
   854	          } else if (controlVariableObservations.length === 0) {
   855	            // No control variables AT ALL — the experiment did not declare any, and none
   856	            // were observed. The outcome can still be classified, but we flag the
   857	            // limitation honestly.
   858	            if (limitations.indexOf(CODES.LIMITATION_NO_CONTROL_VARIABLES) === -1) {
   859	              limitations.push(CODES.LIMITATION_NO_CONTROL_VARIABLES);
   860	            }
   861	          }
   862	        }
   863	
   864	        // ---- Step 13: data quality + direction/magnitude classification cascade --------
   865	        if (classDecision === null) {
   866	          var dataQualityBlocking = dataQualityIssues.length > DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD;
   867	          var hasContradictions = contradictingEvidenceIds.length > 0;
   868	          var directionMatch = (observation.observedDirection === experiment.expectedDirection);
   869	          var magnitudeInRange = (
   870	            observation.observedMagnitude !== null
   871	              && _isFiniteNumber(observation.observedMagnitude)
   872	              && observation.observedMagnitude >= experiment.expectedMagnitudeRange.min
   873	              && observation.observedMagnitude <= experiment.expectedMagnitudeRange.max
   874	          );
   875	
   876	          if (dataQualityBlocking) {
   877	            classDecision = 'inconclusive';
   878	            // Carry the data-quality codes as limitations so the UI can show them honestly.
   879	            for (var dqi = 0; dqi < dataQualityIssues.length && limitations.length < ARRAY_CAP; dqi++) {
   880	              if (limitations.indexOf(dataQualityIssues[dqi]) === -1) limitations.push(dataQualityIssues[dqi]);
   881	            }
   882	          } else if (observation.observedDirection === null) {
   883	            classDecision = 'inconclusive';
   884	          } else if (hasContradictions) {
   885	            // Contradicting evidence blocks confirmed; treat as contradicted irrespective of
   886	            // direction match (the contradicting evidence is itself evidence to the contrary).
   887	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   888	          } else if (!directionMatch) {
   889	            classDecision = 'contradicted';
   890	          } else if (magnitudeInRange) {
   891	            classDecision = 'confirmed';
   892	          } else {
   893	            classDecision = 'partially_confirmed';
   894	          }
   895	        }
   896	      }
   897	
   898	      // ---- Step 14: compose outcome ------------------------------------------------------
   899	      var createdAtIso = resolvedClockIso || appliedChange.appliedAt || experiment.createdAt;
   900	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(createdAtIso) || _isoToMs(createdAtIso) === null) {
   901	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID], { detail: 'could not resolve outcome createdAt ISO' });
   902	      }
   903	      var outcomeIdStr = _outcomeId(experiment.experimentId, appliedChange.changeId);
   904	      // Bound the limitations array.
   905	      if (limitations.length > ARRAY_CAP) limitations = limitations.slice(0, ARRAY_CAP);
   906	
   907	      var outcome = {
   908	        schemaVersion: OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   909	        outcomeId: outcomeIdStr,
   910	        experimentId: experiment.experimentId,
   911	        'class': classDecision,
   912	        observedDirection: observation.observedDirection,
   913	        observedMagnitude: observation.observedMagnitude,
   914	        comparabilityScore: followUp.comparabilityScore,
   915	        confounders: confounders.slice(),
   916	        driverFeedback: observation.driverFeedback,
   917	        dataQualityIssues: dataQualityIssues.slice(),
   918	        sideEffects: sideEffects.slice(),
   919	        limitations: limitations.slice(),
   920	        createdAt: createdAtIso,
   921	      };
   922	
   923	      // ---- Step 15: validate via E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape -----------------------------
   924	      var outCheck = OUT.validateOutcomeShape(outcome);
   925	      if (outCheck.valid !== true) {
   926	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult(
   927	          outCheck.reasonCodes ? outCheck.reasonCodes.slice() : [CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID],
   928	          { detail: 'composed outcome failed E1 OUT.validateOutcomeShape' }
   929	        );
   930	      }
   931	
   932	      // ---- Step 16: envelope byte cap ----------------------------------------------------
   933	      var envelopeBytes;
   934	      try { envelopeBytes = _utf8Bytes(_CAPTURED_JSON_STRINGIFY(outcome)); }
   935	      catch (e) { envelopeBytes = Infinity; }
   936	      if (envelopeBytes > ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP) {
   937	        return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.BYTE_CAP_EXCEEDED], { detail: 'outcome envelope ' + envelopeBytes + ' bytes > ' + ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP });
   938	      }
   939	
   940	      // ---- Step 17: re-check intrinsics post-classify, deep-freeze, register -------------
   941	      if (!_intrinsicsIntact()) {
   942	        return _buildTamperBlock('intrinsic tampering detected post-classify');
   943	      }
   944	      _deepFreeze(outcome);
   945	      _registerAuthoritativeOutcome(outcome);
   946	
   947	      return _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE({ valid: true, outcome: outcome });
   948	
   949	    } catch (eOuter) {
   950	      return RC_E.buildBlockedResult([CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION], { detail: 'classifyOutcome threw on hostile input' });
   951	    }
   952	  }
   953	
   954	  // ---------- Public API ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   955	  var api = {
   956	    SERVICE_VERSION: SERVICE_VERSION,
   957	    OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION: OUTCOME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   958	    ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP: ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP,
   959	    MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON: MIN_COMPARABILITY_FOR_VALID_COMPARISON,
   960	    DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD: DATA_QUALITY_ISSUE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD,
   961	    classifyOutcome: classifyOutcome,
   962	    verifyAuthoritativeOutcome: verifyAuthoritativeOutcome,
   963	  };
   964	  _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(api);
   965	  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
   966	    module.exports = api;
   967	  } else if (root) {
   968	    try { Object.defineProperty(root, 'R3_0E_OutcomeClassifier', { value: api, writable: false, enumerable: false, configurable: false }); }
   969	    catch (e) { root.R3_0E_OutcomeClassifier = api; }
   970	  }
   971	})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this);

codex
`experiment.stopConditions` is not consumed by the classifier after E1 validation; sparse entries fail E1’s element loop because the hole reads as `undefined`. `followUpCaseIds` is only shape-checked by E1 and not read by E3, so I’m treating sparse or named keys there as suspicious only if they can affect E3 behavior, not as an automatic block.

   109	  function hasNonPlainNestedObject(o) {
   110	    // Codex E1-R1-01 closure: recursive descriptor audit. Walks every nested object/array
   111	    // descriptor, rejecting Symbol-keyed own keys, non-enumerable own keys, accessor
   112	    // (get/set) descriptors, non-plain prototypes (class instances / Proxy targets /
   113	    // arbitrary class), and sparse-array hole patterns.
   114	    //
   115	    // Codex E1-R2-01 closure: traversal overflow MUST fail closed (return true). Previous
   116	    // code returned false (clean) when the visit cap was hit, which let a hostile attacker
   117	    // hide a Symbol-keyed / accessor / non-plain object beyond node 4096. The walk now
   118	    // tracks both depth and node count; overflow on either dimension → reject. Depth is
   119	    // tracked per-node via parallel stack so depth>32 also triggers reject.
   120	    try {
   121	      var MAX_DEPTH = 32;
   122	      var MAX_NODES = 4096;

   124	      var visited = 0;
   125	      while (stack.length > 0) {
   126	        if (visited >= MAX_NODES) return true; // fail-closed on node overflow
   127	        var frame = stack.shift(); visited++;

   130	        if (v === null) continue;

   132	        if (t === 'function' || t === 'symbol' || t === 'bigint') return true;
   133	        if (t !== 'object') continue;

   135	        if (!isArr) {
   136	          var p = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   137	          if (!(p === Object.prototype || p === null)) return true;
   138	        } else {

   140	          if (p2 !== Array.prototype) return true;
   141	        }

   143	        var syms;
   144	        try { syms = Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(v); } catch (e) { return true; }
   145	        if (syms && syms.length > 0) return true;

   147	        for (var j = 0; j < names.length; j++) {
   148	          var name = names[j];
   149	          // Array.length is non-enumerable own — skip it from the audit while still
   150	          // walking indexed entries below.

   152	          var d;

   156	          if (d.enumerable !== true) return true;
   157	          stack.push({ v: d.value, depth: frame.depth + 1 });
   158	        }
   159	      }
   160	      return false;
   161	    } catch (e) { return true; }
